_note: Generic Celtic base (BASE_02): a single-language Goidelic (Insular Celtic, Irish/Gaelic) clan culture, seeded directly. The ri/tuath/cland register of cattle-raiding hero-clans bound by the fian war-band and the brithem's law; clan = clanhold (the ri-tuaithe and the oenach assembly). Even split across all three alignments. As the family base, Albawyn provides the seeded Goidelic stock from which intra-family hybrids emerge from base pairs. Goidelic content is drawn directly from culture_cuchulan.json, which is kept separately as the specific clean Goidelic member. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Gaelic register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon through Insular-Celtic phonology (family_celtic.json theonym_set), never real Celtic gods. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English; the conlang Goidelic titles live in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue only.

phonology.palette: Insular Celtic (Goidelic): initial mutation (lenition c>ch, b>bh, t>th, d>dh); broad vs slender consonants; vowels a e i o u (long marks dropped); theophoric stems are the Celtic morphs (Toran-, Orlann-, Realtan-, Gaian-).

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic Mac- (son of) / O / Ua (grandson/descendant of); the kin-group is the fine, the wider clan the cland; praise- and deed-epithets common.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|saint|feature](stem) + element: Dun-derg (red-fort), Ard-mor (great-height), Cill-[name] (church of); patronymic Mac-[father], O-[ancestor].

title_ladder.government: clanhold (ri-tuaithe and the oenach assembly; the brithem judges and the fili sings the king's right)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Insular Celtic (Gaelic) clanhold, ascending; English display titles over the Goidelic conlang co-titles. Built on ri (king) and tuath (petty kingdom): Ri Tuaithe (king of a tuath) principality, Ruiri (over-king) kingdom, Ard-ri (high king) empire over the Ard-rige. Aire (noble) barony; Maor (warden) march; Toisech (sept-chief) county; Flaith (lord) duchy. A clan culture rarely rises past the ri-tuaithe. The brithem (judge) and fili (poet-seer) stand outside the ladder. (Native rank titles are the real Gaelic register, allowed.)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH. The *_native conlang forms (Goidelic) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: personal + Mac-[father] / O-[ancestor] patronymic; the fine (kin) and a deed/animal epithet for the renowned (the Hound, the Red).
people_name_convention.dual_register: the ri-kin carry a cland name and a praise-epithet from the fili; commoners a patronymic.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names from the Celtic deity-morphs + an element: Mael- (devotee/tonsured-of), Gilla- (servant-of), Cu- (hound/champion-of): e.g. Mael-Toran, Gilla-Realtan, Cu-Orlann.

religion._note: Deity-names are phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon through Insular-Celtic phonology (family_celtic.json theonym_set) - never real Celtic gods. All three alignments: Lawful kin keep the sun-and-oath powers; Neutral the ancestral dead, the land and the nature-powers; Chaotic the war-fury and raven powers. Druidic: the drui and the fili mediate; the Tuath-de are the god-kin.
religion.the_one: Eternan (< Aeternus; the Ancient One beyond the god-kin, seldom petitioned)

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Eternan, Toran the just brightness, Orlann of the sworn oath, Realtan the merciful - and names the Chaotic powers as the demon-kin, warded; the sun-oath and the brithem's law bind alike.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: keeps the ancestral dead of the fine, the land and the nature-powers (the Tuath-de, the sidhe, the holy wells and cairns); the great powers invoked at the nemed situationally.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - the war-fury and the raven powers - and names the Lawful powers, and Eternan, as the powers to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the opposing powers keep their Celtic morphs + a portfolio epithet (distinct per power): Maraxus -> Maragan the War-Fire; Vacidus -> Faicid the Unmaker; Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nemed (sacred grove) of [power]: 'the Nemed of Toran'.
religion.saints_pattern: the Tuath-de (the god-kin) and the ancestral heroes of the fine, honored at the cairn and the holy well; the Lawful add 'Naomh [name]' (saint).

holy_symbol_motifs.Toran: a triskele sun-wheel over crossed oak
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlann: an iron spear crossed with a torc (oath-ring)

banks_patterns.ships: curach river-boats and chariot-names (inland forest-and-hill folk): 'the Grey Hound', 'Raven of the Glenn'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [cland] Fian (warrior-band) / the [animal] spears: 'the Fian of the Red Branch', 'the Hound-spears'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Salmon of Wisdom', 'The Boar and Cauldron'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen raths and sidhe-mounds: 'the Rath of [name]', 'the Sidhe of [hill]'
